Opinion No. 91 s. 2011 DEC 02 2011 MR. ISAGANI YAP SB Member Ibal Zambales Dear Mr. Yap: This has reference to your letter, requesting this Department's opinion on the opinion rendered by our Regional Director, Florida M. Dijan. A perusal of your letter would reveal that the issue to be resolved is which between the representations of the Vice Mayor and the minutes as reflected in the Sanggunian's journal relative to the two-thirds vote mustered by the sangguniang bayan members to override the veto of the mayor, would prevail. In reply thereto, please be informed that the journal of the sanggunian which contains the official deliberation and minutes of the debates and discussions that occurred during a particular session prevails over the Vice-Mayor's representations, given the fact that the latter embodies the official acts of the sanggunian. Hence, any question as to actions, deliberations as well as voting of the sanggunian in a particular session would be best addressed by the journal of that session. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly YOUrS, J SUS OQ Director lil LS:87/17/11 E: Director Florida M. Dijan, CESO IV DILG Region Ill Barangay Maimpis, San Fernando, Pampanga Vice Mayor Lydia Y. Mayormita Iba, Zambales
